title: Caesar Salad
summary: Extremely rich and creamy salad which goes suuuper well with lasagne...
extendedSummary: Extremely rich and creamy salad which goes suuuper well with lasagne. I wanted to try recreate the same caesar salad that the bmd chefs made for a chicken parma at lunch, since I couldn't stop thinking about it... this comes kind of close but not quite as yummy as their one.

items: 1 teaspoon anchovy paste (or two tiny jarred anchovies ground to a paste)
2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, from one lemon
1 teaspoon Dijon mustard (I like the brand Maille)
1 cup mayonnaise, best quality such as Hellmann's Real

method: In a medium bowl, whisk together the garlic, anchovy paste, lemon juice, Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Add the mayonnaise, Parmigiano-Reggiano, salt and pepper and whisk until well combined. Taste and adjust to your liking. The dressing will keep well in the fridge for about a week.
Chop lettuce in half length ways, remove hard base (with a triangle incission), slice in half length ways again, then start chopping horizontally to create bite sized pieces, then rinse thoroughly
Add dressing to lettuce, croutons (optional), and sprinkle shaved parmesan on top
